## Semiconductor / AI Corporate News

- SMIC [will report quarterly financial results on February 11](https://news.futunn.com/hk/post/68448643/earnings-preview-smic-to-report-financial-results-on-february-11), with analysts forecasting Q4 2025 revenue of $2.416 billion (up 9.46% YoY) and EPS of $0.021 (up 111% YoY).
- MediaTek [unveiled its Dimensity 9500s and Dimensity 8500 chipsets](https://www.mediatek.com/press-room/news/mediatek-unveils-dimensity-9500s-and-dimensity-8500-to-propel-performance-gaming-and-efficiency-in-flagship-and-premium-smartphones) to boost performance, gaming, and efficiency in flagship and premium smartphones.
- NVIDIA [celebrated six years of GeForce NOW](https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/geforce-now-thursday-feb-2026-games-list/) by surpassing 1 billion hours streamed and adding 24 new games to its cloud platform in February.
- Samsung [showcased AI-driven and hyperconnected HVAC solutions](https://news.samsung.com/global/interview-growth-through-hvac-samsung-leads-the-market-with-ai-and-hyperconnected-solutions) at AHR Expo 2026, aiming to expand in North America with sustainable, high-efficiency products and strategic partnerships.
- AMD [saw Cathie Wood’s ARK Funds increase holdings](https://news.google.?oc=5) after a recent drop in share price, reflecting continued confidence in the chipmaker.
- OpenAI [released GPT-5.3-Codex](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYEFVX3lxTE1WSFdyRV9lZDd3TTJWVlhKY1pWMTRaSHJaa0hLU05kTE1QcGVjRVdndHhuNnFhQW5ObmtkcFhpRm1wd21yU1o2dDRYUWE2aDJzX1p4ZERNVlZjSHlaMTl6Qw?oc=5), advancing its AI language model capabilities for coding and reasoning tasks.
- OpenAI [announced its new coding model helped develop itself](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxQbnY5a0U5cGNobEFWLVJVTklzRGlWT3dtQ192WF9vZ1I4NVRnNEdBNldyRGNsNGZjc0pKQjdSZTB6Qzd4TXhWdEdscVVNNHBjVERKal9vN0ZCdnNDeHBubjI1d0lIdHFQSndZUEtfVmJ6NTFGVjU4T21tN1dRYzU5eWhHc0VLVXZpS3ZSUWM2QVNuSFFhcnEzVEJyQmduYzA?oc=5), highlighting self-improving AI development processes.
- ASML [began high-volume shipments of $350M High-NA EUV lithography machines](https://news.google.?oc=5) to Intel and Samsung, enabling next-generation chip manufacturing.
- Anthropic [launched Claude Opus 4.6](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-opus-4-6), an upgraded AI model with a 1 million token context window and enhanced coding, reasoning, and multitasking capabilities.
- Cambricon [returned to profitability with estimated 2025 net profit of 1.85 billion yuan](https://news.futunn.com/post/68529447), driven by AI chip R&D and market expansion, with revenue between 6 and 7 billion yuan.
- Moore Threads and PONY-W [announced a strategic partnership](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE1BZ0Y5SXNHbS1CV2phTDhpUDF4OU9LbVJta3BzczdfX0FQa2t1SWJfeURvcnRmdUNkX1hHZWs4SkI2MmxCUFlOeWRNY1d6WG9raVdGTk5BNVdrWThoaXhsNkRhQzdHSS1xeTlQSDd3RXg?oc=5) to accelerate large-scale deployment of autonomous driving in China using domestic AI computing power.
